title: Spiced Apple Crumble with Prunes
description: A warm and comforting dessert featuring tender apples, sweet prunes, and a crunchy crumble topping.
instructions: Peel, core, and slice the apples into a bowl.
Add the prunes, brown sugar, and Indian spices to the bowl with the apples.
Transfer the apple mixture to a baking dish.
Mix the gluten-free flour and cold butter in a separate bowl until crumbly.
Add the herbal tea to the flour mixture and mix until a crumbly topping forms.
Spread the crumble topping evenly over the apple mixture.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown and the apples are tender.
Serve warm, topped with vanilla ice cream if desired.
